@graph.description: TRFOnepack is a case packing machine from TRF Industrial Automation that erects the case, loads the products robotically and seals the case in one integrated system, for applications of about 20 to 50 products per minute.

mainEntity.name: What Floor Space Does an Integrated Case Packing Machine Require?

acceptedAnswer.text: The space depends on the case formats, the product infeed and how the machine sits in your line. The principle stays the same: TRFOnepack consolidates case erecting, packing and sealing into one machine architecture, so it replaces three separate frames and the conveyors between them. TRF confirms the footprint for your plant with a layout study during the application review.

mainEntity.name: How Much Does a Case Packing Machine Cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on your products, case formats, rates and the integration scope around the machine. TRFOnepack combines erecting, packing and sealing in one capital project, so the scope is defined once instead of three times. Payback comes from the manual labor removed across those three steps, the shifts the line runs and the separate machines you no longer need to buy and connect.

mainEntity.name: How Fast Can a Case Packer Change Over Between SKUs?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on what changes between the SKUs. On TRFOnepack, robotic loading supports multiple products, recipes and packing patterns within the validated application envelope, so a product or pattern change starts with a stored recipe. A new case size also involves the erecting and sealing steps, so TRF defines the case format range and the changeover plan before the design is confirmed.

mainEntity.name: What Is the Difference Between a Case Packer and a Case Erector?

acceptedAnswer.text: A case erector forms a flat corrugated blank into an open case; a case packer loads products into that case. TRFOnepack does both and seals the case as well, in one machine. TRF does not sell stand-alone case erectors: case forming exists inside TRFOnepack and inside end-of-line integration projects that TRF engineers around its case packing platforms.

mainEntity.name: Can Case Packing Equipment Integrate With My Existing Palletizer and Conveyors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because TRFOnepack seals the case, what leaves the machine is a finished shipping unit ready for conveying. TRF engineers the interfaces to conveyors and palletizers already in your plant, and TRFIntraflow covers the integration layer with sensors, PLC and HMI, machine communication and palletizer interfaces. Existing equipment and controls are reviewed with your team before the scope is defined.

mainEntity.name: Who Supplies Case Packing Equipment for Food and CPG Manufacturers in the US?

acceptedAnswer.text: TRF supplies top-load case packing equipment to food and CPG manufacturers across the United States: TRFOnepack for integrated erecting, packing and sealing, TRFRapidpack for high-mix robotic packing and TRFDroppack for gravity packing of flexible packages. TRF also supplies the conveying and palletizing around them, so one partner answers for the whole end of line.
